items.title: 4.1 Graphical User Interface (GUI) Development with Tkinter

source_refs.note: Topic 4.1 as printed (PDF 49, printed 45); since 2026-10-29 only the text before its first sub-heading (each sub-heading has its own lesson).

blocks.text: Graphical User Interface (GUI) development allows programs to interact with users through visual elements like windows, buttons, labels, and text boxes (as shown in Figure 4.1). GUIs make applications more user-friendly and easier to use compared to command-line interfaces. Python provides tools to create GUI applications efficiently. Tkinter is Python's built-in library for creating GUI programs. It is simple, widely used, and allows developers to design interactive applications quickly.
